query.query: SELECT l.areasymbol,s.saverest,m.mukey,c.cokey,c.compname,c.comppct_r,c.drainagecl,c.hydgrp,h.chkey,h.hzdept_r,h.hzdepb_r,h.awc_r,h.om_r,h.ksat_r FROM mapunit m INNER JOIN legend l ON m.lkey=l.lkey INNER JOIN sacatalog s ON l.areasymbol=s.areasymbol INNER JOIN component c ON m.mukey=c.mukey LEFT JOIN chorizon h ON c.cokey=h.cokey WHERE m.mukey IN (SELECT mukey FROM SDA_Get_Mukey_from_intersection_with_WktWgs84('POLYGON((-93.654 42.022,-93.646 42.022,-93.646 42.028,-93.654 42.028,-93.654 42.022))')) ORDER BY m.mukey,c.cokey,h.hzdept_r
